mapper.select: SELECT activity_id, team_id, name, location, content, number_volunteers, post_date, start_date, end_date, state,url,sort FROM volunteer_activity WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%') AND state=1 AND location LIKE CONCAT('%', #{location}, '%') AND sort LIKE CONCAT('%', #{sort}, '%') LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM volunteer_activity WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%') AND state=1 AND location LIKE CONCAT('%', #{location}, '%') AND sort LIKE CONCAT('%', #{sort}, '%')
SELECT activity_id, team_id, name, location, content, number_volunteers, post_date, start_date, end_date, state, url,sort FROM volunteer_activity WHERE team_id = #{teamId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO volunteer_activity (team_id, name, location, content, number_volunteers, post_date, start_date, end_date, state, url,sort) VALUES (#{volunteerActivity.teamId}, #{volunteerActivity.name}, #{volunteerActivity.location}, #{volunteerActivity.content}, #{volunteerActivity.numberVolunteers}, #{volunteerActivity.postDate}, #{volunteerActivity.startDate}, #{volunteerActivity.endDate}, 0, #{volunteerActivity.url},#{volunteerActivity.sort})
mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(va.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, CAST(IFNULL(SUM(vsr.service_hours), 0) AS UNSIGNED) AS time FROM volunteer_activity va LEFT JOIN volunteer_service_record vsr ON va.activity_id = vsr.activity_id WHERE YEAR(va.start_date) = #{year} AND vsr.volunteer_id = #{volunteerId} GROUP BY date ORDER BY date
